items.title: Actual PBPS scalar defect: unique positive real root

items.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², let 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X∼μ,Z∼N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J. The laws μ,J,ν are probabilities. There exists a Markov kernel S whose every-state normalized density is S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)), with Λ.IsCondKernel S and Λ.fst=Λ.snd=ν. There exists a bounded selfadjoint T on the actual real L²(ν) such that for every u, ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-almost everywhere, and ∫Tu dν=∫u dν. Its full scalar defect D=I−T² is positive. There exists a bounded positive REAL Γ with Γ²=D and for EVERY scalar u, ‖Γu‖²=‖u‖²−‖Tu‖². Probability, kernel, T, D positivity and Γ are conclusions; no supplied CFC/root/commutation or finite-dimensional L² certificate is assumed. For EVERY bounded positive REAL alternative Γprime on this SAME marginal whose square is this SAME D, Γprime=Γ. No energy identity is assumed for an alternative. This uniqueness quantifier lies outside the earlier every-u energy assertion. Printed joint/macro ΓP and B.11 still require SAME onto-M transport and the typed B*B identity, which remain separate.
assumptions: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², let 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X∼μ,Z∼N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J.

Probability laws, normalized S, stationary disintegration, scalar T and positive D/root are conclusions. Any alternative needs only positivity and SAME-square equality; uniqueness is outside the every-observable energy quantifier.
Finite base E does not imply finite L²; rank-zero E and legal αη=1 are retained.
